discussion_comments.comment_body: Can you also add a separate test that uses the shared Chalk instance not `new chalk.Instance`?
@toonijn this is marked resolved but I don't see where this is happening.
It wasn't resolved yet. Now it should be.
I also couldn't find a test for escaping the arg. Can you add one?
Can you move this out into a helper that accepts `__dirname` as an argument?
Potentially, but this is the only way to really guarantee what we want. I feel more comfortable with this since `supports-color`'s behavior might change.

It's probably wise to also add a test for the caching of multiple styles, where a new style using the same 'substyle' as the cache is created.

``` javascript
var redBold = chalk.red.bold
var blueBold = chalk.blue.bold
assert.notEqual(blueBold('foo'), redBold('foo')
```

This will catch a more subtle version of the current bug, where the `_styles` array is not shared globally, but per-style. This is what I ran into when attempting a naive fix last night ;-)
